name: MAGICapp_list_guidelines
description: Find clinical practice guidelines on MAGICapp (Making GRADE the Irresistible Choice), the platform for GRADE-based living guidelines of WHO (including maternal and perinatal health), BMJ Rapid Recommendations / MAGIC, the European Stroke Organisation, Cancer Council Australia, EAES and other societies: about 460 public guidelines, half in English. Give query words (a condition, intervention or organization, e.g. 'stroke thrombolysis', 'postpartum haemorrhage', 'WHO tuberculosis'); a guideline matches when its name, organization or description holds every word (word beginnings: 'pregnan' finds pregnancy), and when none holds them all the guidelines holding most of them are returned and metadata.matched_by says so. language filters by code ('en' also matches 'en-gb'). Without a query, lists guidelines newest first. Returns each guideline's publishedId, name, owner, language, publication date, number of published recommendations and link, with metadata.matching and next_offset for paging (limit at most 100). Pass publishedId (not guidelineId, the unpublished draft) as guideline_id to MAGICapp_get_recommendations for the GRADE-rated recommendation statements, or to MAGICapp_get_sections / MAGICapp_get_guideline.

query.description: Words to find in a guideline's name, organization or description, e.g. 'stroke thrombolysis' or 'WHO maternal'. Omit to list all.

language.description: Language code to keep, e.g. 'en' (also matches 'en-gb'), 'nl', 'dk'. Omit for all languages.

offset.description: Matching guidelines to skip, for paging (metadata.next_offset).

publishedId.description: Id of the published version: pass it as guideline_id to MAGICapp_get_recommendations, MAGICapp_get_sections or MAGICapp_get_guideline; check isLatestPublished before using it

guidelineId.description: Id of the current draft (often not public)

publishDate.description: Date of the guideline itself, which can be years before lastEdit

description.description: The guideline's own description, one of the fields the query is matched against, capped at metadata.description_characters

description_truncated.description: True when description was cut at that cap

institutionName.description: Institution that owns the guideline; a searched field

mainEditor.description: Editor or editorial team named by MAGICapp

countryFlag.description: Country code MAGICapp shows as a flag

publishCreationTime.description: When this published version was created

publishLastSearchDate.description: When the evidence was last searched: the GRADE currency marker

startDate.description: When work on the guideline started

lastEdit.description: When the guideline was last edited, a living guideline's currency

versionLabel.description: Version of the published guideline, e.g. '1.2'

isLatestPublished.description: False when publishedId is a superseded published version

pdfPublishedPath.description: Direct link to the published guideline as PDF

jsonPath.description: Direct link to the published guideline as JSON

name: MAGICapp_get_guideline
description: Get detailed information about a specific clinical guideline from MAGICapp by its numeric guideline ID. Returns comprehensive guideline metadata including title, authoring organization, contact information, version details, GRADE methodology settings, and links to PDF/JSON exports. Use MAGICapp_list_guidelines first to find guideline IDs, then use this tool to get full details. For the guideline's clinical recommendations, use MAGICapp_get_recommendations instead.

guideline_id.description: Numeric guideline ID (use the publishedId from MAGICapp_list_guidelines, e.g., 10962, 10258, 7594)

enableDA.description: True when the guideline has decision aids enabled in MAGICapp, e.g. true.

name: MAGICapp_get_recommendations
description: Get all clinical recommendations from a specific MAGICapp guideline. Returns GRADE-rated recommendations with strength levels (STRONG, WEAK, PRACTICE, NO_STRENGTH), recommendation text (HTML), supporting remarks, rationale, and key information including evidence quality assessments. This is the core tool for accessing evidence-based clinical recommendations from living guidelines hosted on MAGICapp. Use MAGICapp_list_guidelines first to find guideline IDs.

guideline_id.description: Numeric guideline ID (use the publishedId from MAGICapp_list_guidelines, e.g., 10962 for oral cancer screening, 10258 for WHO mpox guidelines)

setting.description: Clinical setting the PICO applies to. Measured null on all 3 PICOs -- absence means unstated, so the PICO should not be assumed to be setting-general.

showPicots.description: True when the PICO is displayed in full PICOT form (adding timing), e.g. false. A display flag, not a property of the evidence.

showAdaptation.description: True when the recommendation is displayed as an adaptation of another guideline, e.g. false.

statusComment.description: What that status means in words, e.g. 'Evidence search updated through November 26, 2025'. This is the field that dates the EVIDENCE rather than the document -- a recommendation published in 2026 on a 2025 evidence search is current only up to that search.

statusDate.description: Date of the recommendation's current status, 'YYYY-MM-DD', e.g. '2026-03-02'. Present on 4 of the 6 recommendations measured.

name: MAGICapp_get_sections
description: Get all sections (chapters) of a specific MAGICapp clinical guideline. Returns the structural organization of the guideline including section headings, text content, section types, and hierarchical ordering. Use this to understand the guideline's structure and find specific clinical topics within a guideline. Sections contain the narrative text while recommendations are accessed separately via MAGICapp_get_recommendations.

guideline_id.description: Numeric guideline ID (use the publishedId from MAGICapp_list_guidelines, e.g., 10962 for oral cancer screening, 10258 for WHO mpox guidelines)

name: NCI_get_drug_by_name
description: Get detailed information about a cancer drug from the NCI Drug Dictionary by its pretty-url-name (slug). Returns comprehensive drug information including definition, aliases (brand names, chemical names, code names, CAS registry numbers), NCI concept ID, and links to drug information summaries. The pretty-url-name is a lowercase hyphenated slug (e.g., 'pembrolizumab', 'tamoxifen-citrate', 'nivolumab'). You can find drug names from NCIDrugDict_search results (prettyUrlName field).

drug_name.description: Pretty URL name (slug) of the drug (e.g., 'pembrolizumab', 'tamoxifen-citrate', 'nivolumab', 'trastuzumab')

name: NCI_expand_drugs_by_letter
description: Browse one page of the NCI Drug Dictionary by first letter. The response includes an exact total and offset navigation metadata; continue with metadata.next_offset, passing it as from/from_ in the generated wrapper, while metadata.has_more is true. Use NCI_get_drug_by_name with prettyUrlName for full details.

letter.description: First letter to browse by (a-z, or '#' for drugs starting with numbers/special characters)

size.description: Number of results per page (default: 100, max: 10000)

from.description: Zero-based record offset (generated Python wrapper name: from_). Continue with metadata.next_offset.

name: DailyMed_search_drug_classes
description: Search the DailyMed database for FDA Established Pharmacologic Classes (EPC). Returns drug class names and NDF-RT codes that categorize drugs by their mechanism of action or pharmacologic effect. Use this to find drug classes for a specific therapeutic area (e.g., 'antihypertensive', 'antibiotic', 'antineoplastic') or to look up specific pharmacologic class codes. The drug class codes can be used to search DailyMed_search_spls for all drugs in that class. metadata.total_matches is the exact number of matching classes across the whole catalogue; request further pages with `page` while page * pagesize < total_matches.

drug_class_name.description: Search term for drug class name (e.g., 'anti', 'kinase inhibitor', 'antibacterial', 'antineoplastic', 'angiotensin')

pagesize.description: Number of matching classes per page (1-100; default: 100).

page.description: One-based page number of the matches (default: 1).

return_schema.description: Drug classes whose name contains the search term. DailyMed cannot filter, so `data` is the matching subset of its catalogue and `metadata` records that ToolUniverse applied the filter. On failure `status` is 'error', `error` carries the reason and `data` is absent.

data.description: The matches on the requested page. Empty when nothing matched, which is an answer rather than a failure.

drug_class_name.description: The term that was searched for.

total_matches.description: Matches across the whole catalogue, not just this page.

classes_searched.description: Size of the catalogue that was filtered, 1210 today.

upstream_pages_read.description: DailyMed pages fetched to assemble it; it caps a page at 100.

filtered_by.description: Records that the filter was applied by ToolUniverse, not upstream.
